# Skills

<!-- Generated by tools/reference.ts from src/content. Don't edit: run `npm run docs:tables`. -->

Each class plays its riff (free), six skills unlocked by level, and a solo. **Funk** is the cost.

## Trumpet (`trumpet`)

| Unlock | Skill | Funk | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Riff | Brass Stab (`tr_riff`) | 0 | HOT ×1.0. |
| Level 1 | Hot Lick (`tr_s1`) | 6 | HOT ×1.5 on one enemy; 30% Scorched. |
| Level 3 | Shake (`tr_s2`) | 9 | 3 hits of HOT ×0.6 on random enemies; each 15% Scorched. |
| Level 5 | Plunger Wah (`tr_s3`) | 8 | HOT ×0.8 and The Blues on one enemy. |
| Level 7 | Scream Note (`tr_s4`) | 16 | HOT ×2.6 on one enemy; you take 5% of max Heart as recoil. |
| Level 10 | Across the River (`tr_s5`) | 20 | HOT ×1.3 on all enemies; you gain Hyped. |
| Level 13 | Triple-Tongue Inferno (`tr_s6`) | 24 | 4 hits of HOT ×0.9 on one enemy; guaranteed Scorched. |
| Solo | Archangel Call (`tr_solo`) | 0 | HOT ×3.5 on all enemies and Scorched on all; you gain Up-Tempo. |

## Trombone (`trombone`)

| Unlock | Skill | Funk | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Riff | Slide Swat (`tb_riff`) | 0 | BLUE ×1.0. |
| Level 1 | Smear (`tb_s1`) | 6 | BLUE ×1.3; 40% The Blues. |
| Level 3 | Growl (`tb_s2`) | 8 | BLUE ×1.2; heal for 50% of the damage dealt. |
| Level 5 | Tailgate Reach (`tb_s3`) | 7 | BLUE ×1.6; can't be dodged and ignores half the target's Grit. |
| Level 7 | Dirge (`tb_s4`) | 12 | The Blues and Rattled on all enemies; your next damaging skill this battle deals +50%. |
| Level 10 | Gutbucket (`tb_s5`) | 18 | BLUE ×(1.5 + 1.5 × the fraction of your Heart that's missing). |
| Level 13 | Cut the Body Loose (`tb_s6`) | 22 | BLUE ×1.4 on all enemies, rising to ×2.2 plus Encore on you if you used Dirge last turn or any enemy has The Blues. |
| Solo | Tailgate Jubilee (`tb_solo`) | 0 | Heal 50% of Heart, cleanse yourself, and BLUE ×3.0 on all enemies. |
